item.title: Wanko no Yomeiri ~Arata na Nihon no Shippo~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Alumi Soft
  • 発売日: 2019-08-30
  • スコア: 7.31/10 (23 人評価)
  • 日本語名: わんこの嫁入り～新たな二本のしっぽ～
  • 英語名: Wanko no Yomeiri Arata na Nihon no Shippo

あらすじ

Days after Touya married the dog-eared divine messengers Koharu and Azuki, the shrine cafe “Inu no Shippo” had become quite popular and they enjoyed their time together passionately. However, two new divine messengers Fubuki and Kaede came to monitor them one day. What will become of their private lives?
